ready.body:
FIX ROUND 1 (OPENING) (B-LEADER-125, agent 125) — growth-project-mobile#438 @ 27f773f330a05cdf843f6f8b6c36d1da8295f9c5 — READY FOR AUDIT

CI green at this head: Typecheck, lint, test (lint, typecheck, full jest) SUCCESS; CodeQL and both Analyze jobs SUCCESS. Merge state CLEAN.
Size: 297 changed lines (260+/37-), 7 files, no lockfile, no new dependency, no migration, no new flag. Mobile-only; uses the existing GET /me/leaderboard and POST /me/leaderboard/opt-in, live in production since deploy 9.
Audit: no privacy B. Opt-in default OFF (DB default false); display name only (user-set or "First L."); no health numbers in the response; roster scoped by coach_id; non-opted viewers excluded from entries.
Fixes U1-U6 (listed in the body). Owner decision needed before merge: SoT A7 / OR-113-13 kept the leaderboard off for launch; owner 15:06 asked to turn it on.
